name: dev-design-infra
description: Design an infra/devops runbook for migrations, shutdowns, deployments, DNS cutover, IaC changes, database operations, or maintenance — with live-state verification, phased execution, rollback gates, and destruction checklists. Triggers: 'migrate cluster', 'shutdown cluster', 'move to serverless', 'drain workloads', 'infra plan', 'devops runbook', 'IaC destroy', 'DNS cutover plan'. Writes the runbook only — never executes it; a human runs it on their own authority.
author: txdat
